description: bits-ui's Progress compiled from its published source through shadcn-svelte's unmodified progress wrapper and its demo: the demo's onMount timer moves the value from 13 to 66 after 500 ms and the indicator's transform transitions (transition-all, sampled on the stopped timeline at 16 ms frames); a second bar's value and max change from the app (role progressbar, aria-valuenow/min/max, data-state loading/loaded/indeterminate, data-value, data-indeterminate for a null value, the indicator's style text built from value and max). The bars' areas are compared as pixel regions while the transitions run and once they settled
